se_pattern: proxy component like esv::Item (Item.h: struct Item : public BaseProxyComponent, DEFINE_COMPONENT(ServerItem, "esv::Item")); ECS.inl:1356 has E(ClientItem) commented out.

fields.name: VMT
fields.evidence: Toolkit ctor ecl::Item::Item(GameObjectTemplate const*) EoCClient.dll+0x1118D00 stores the ITextKeyEventHandler vtable; live: module pointer, same in all 12 samples.

fields.name: LoggableObjectVMT
fields.evidence: Same ctor stores the ILoggableObject vtable at +8; live module pointer (VMT + 0x18 region).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Ctor writes null handle 0xffc0000000000000; live = the item's own entity handle (same as EntityRef.Handle). esv::Item has the same EntityHandle field_10 (Item.h).

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: Ctor writes 8 bytes of 0; live bit sets 0x1 / 0x80 / 0x81 / 0x86 / 0x400000.. and bit 0x2000 in the high dword - a flag word like esv::Item.Flags (ItemFlags, 8 bytes, at the same offset). Client bit meanings not established.

fields.name: EntityRef
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor ecl::Item::GetEntityRef, game offset +0x20 confirmed (bg3.exe+0xF75B90); live handle + world pointer.

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: Ctor writes 4 bytes of 0 at +0x30; live always 0.

fields.name: CurrentLevel
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor ecl::Item::GetCurrentLevel, game offset +0x34 confirmed (bg3.exe+0x1853E80); live FixedString (same as the triggers' Level).

fields.name: ItemType
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor ecl::Item::GetItemType, game offset +0x38 (bg3.exe+0x179F960); ctor initialises it to the FixedString "Common"; live one constant FixedString.

fields.name: Flags2
fields.evidence: Ctor: byte +0x3C = (byte & 0x81) | 1 - a bit field byte; live 1 or 9. Bit meanings unknown.

fields.name: _Pad3D
fields.evidence: alignment padding before the pointer at +0x40; live 0.

fields.name: Template
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor ecl::Item::GetTemplate (GameObjectTemplate const*), game offset +0x40 confirmed (bg3.exe+0x1C7DED0); live heap pointer.

fields.name: ItemMachine
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessors Get/SetItemMachine (ecl::ItemMachine*) at +0x48 (Toolkit offset); ctor writes 0; live heap pointer in all samples.

fields.name: StatusMachine
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessors Get/SetStatusMachine (ecl::StatusMachine*) at +0x50 (Toolkit offset); ctor writes 0; live heap pointer in all samples.

fields.name: field_58
fields.evidence: Ctor writes 0; live always 0 (possibly a pointer that is set only for some items).

fields.name: field_60
fields.evidence: Ctor writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle); live always null.

fields.name: _Pad6B
fields.evidence: padding to the class end 0x70 (live +0x6C = 0 or 0xF: garbage).

fields.name: _Pad70
fields.evidence: Registry size 120 is 8 more than the class (0x70, last ctor store at +0x6A); live +0x70 is mostly the ecl::Item VMT value = next element. Same +8 as the trigger proxy components (see ecl.CullTrigger.json).

open_questions: Offsets come from the Toolkit ctor; the game's own ctor was not located (game offsets confirmed only for EntityRef, CurrentLevel, ItemType, Template). Live data agrees with all of them.
Meaning of Flags / Flags2 bits and of field_30, field_58, field_60, field_68, field_6A.
